title: pkg/testutils: DiffTest struct, RunDiffTests harness, TimestampNormalizer, file-state comparison (prd001 R1-R5)
description:
deliverable_type: code

required_reading:
  - docs/specs/product-requirements/prd001-testutils.yaml (full PRD -- defines DiffTest struct, RunDiffTests API, normalization hooks, file-state comparison requirements R1-R5 and acceptance criteria AC1-AC6)
  - docs/ARCHITECTURE.yaml (pkg/testutils component description -- differential testing harness role in the pipeline, relationship to cmd/ packages)
  - go.mod (module path github.com/petar-djukic/go-unix-utils and Go version)

files:
  - path: pkg/testutils/difftest.go
    action: create
    note: DiffTest struct with Args, Stdin, Env, ExitCode, Normalize, ExpectedFiles fields; Normalize function type (func([]byte) []byte)
  - path: pkg/testutils/runner.go
    action: create
    note: RunDiffTests(t, goBinary, refBinary, tests) function; binary execution via exec.CommandContext; stdout/stderr/exit-code capture and comparison; divergence reporting; t.Run subtests
  - path: pkg/testutils/normalizers.go
    action: create
    note: TimestampNormalizer replacing common strftime patterns with "TIMESTAMP"; ComposeNormalizers helper applying a slice of normalizers in order
  - path: pkg/testutils/filestate.go
    action: create
    note: File-content comparison for utilities whose primary output is a file rather than stdout (sponge, cp, mv)
  - path: pkg/testutils/runner_test.go
    action: create
    note: Tests for RunDiffTests (passing and failing cases), TimestampNormalizer (pattern replacement), file-state comparison (matching and divergent files), timeout behavior

requirements:
  - id: R1
    text: |
      Define DiffTest struct per prd001-testutils R1.1-R1.4. Fields: Name (string, used as
      t.Run subtest name), Args ([]string, command-line arguments passed to both binaries),
      Stdin ([]byte, nil means no stdin/immediate EOF), Env ([]string, nil means inherit test
      process environment), ExitCode (int, expected exit code -- not used for comparison between
      binaries, only documents intent), Normalize ([]Normalize, nil or empty means no
      normalization), WorkDir (string, optional working directory; empty means create per-test
      temp directory), ExpectedFiles (map[string][]byte, nil means no file-state check).
      Define Normalize as func([]byte) []byte.
  - id: R2
    text: |
      Implement RunDiffTests(t *testing.T, goBinary string, refBinary string, tests []DiffTest)
      per prd001-testutils R2.1-R2.5. For each DiffTest, invoke both goBinary and refBinary
      with identical Args, Stdin, and Env. Capture stdout and stderr into separate byte buffers
      and record the exit code from each binary independently. Impose a configurable timeout
      (default 10 seconds) on each binary invocation using exec.CommandContext with
      context.WithTimeout. If either binary exceeds the timeout, fail the test with a message
      naming the binary and its args. When WorkDir is empty, create a temporary directory via
      t.TempDir() for each binary invocation. Produce no output to stdout or stderr during a
      passing test run (use t.Errorf/t.Fatalf only on failure).
  - id: R3
    text: |
      Implement comparison and reporting per prd001-testutils R3.1-R3.6. Before comparing,
      apply the DiffTest.Normalize slice (each function in order) to both binaries' stdout and
      stderr. Compare normalized stdout byte-for-byte; any difference is a test failure. Compare
      normalized stderr byte-for-byte; any difference is a test failure. Compare exit codes
      exactly; a difference is a test failure. On any divergence, report in the failure message:
      the DiffTest.Args, the Stdin content (truncated to 256 bytes if longer), the reference
      binary stdout, the Go binary stdout, the reference binary stderr, the Go binary stderr,
      and both exit codes. Run each DiffTest as a named subtest via t.Run(test.Name, ...) so
      individual failures are identifiable in go test output.
  - id: R4
    text: |
      Implement normalization hooks per prd001-testutils R4.1-R4.3. Provide a
      TimestampNormalizer (a Normalize function) that uses regexp to replace common strftime
      timestamp patterns with the fixed string "TIMESTAMP". Patterns to match: "Mon DD HH:MM:SS"
      (e.g., "Feb 19 14:05:32"), "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS" (e.g., "2024-02-19T14:05:32"),
      "HH:MM:SS" standalone elapsed-time format (e.g., "00:00:05"). Provide a
      ComposeNormalizers(norms ...Normalize) Normalize function that returns a single Normalize
      applying each norm in order. When the DiffTest.Normalize slice is nil or empty, no
      normalization is applied.
  - id: R5
    text: |
      Implement file-state comparison per prd001-testutils R5.1-R5.2. When
      DiffTest.ExpectedFiles is non-nil, after both binaries have exited, for each key in
      ExpectedFiles read the file at that path (relative to the binary's working directory)
      from both the Go binary's and the reference binary's working directories. Compare file
      contents byte-for-byte. Report file-content divergence in the same format as stdout
      divergence (file path, expected content from reference binary workdir, actual content
      from Go binary workdir).

design_decisions:
  - id: D1
    text: |
      DiffTest is the primary exported type; its definition goes in difftest.go per the project
      naming convention (Go packages name the primary source file after the primary exported
      type, not the package name -- testutils/testutils.go is forbidden).
  - id: D2
    text: |
      Use exec.CommandContext with context.WithTimeout for the 10-second default timeout per
      prd001-testutils R2.3. Extract the exit code from the *exec.ExitError type assertion on
      the error returned by cmd.Run(). When the context deadline is exceeded, report timeout
      with the binary path and args.
  - id: D3
    text: |
      Run each DiffTest as t.Run(test.Name, func(t *testing.T) { ... }) per prd001-testutils
      R3.6 so that individual test case failures are identifiable in go test -v output and can
      be filtered with go test -run.
  - id: D4
    text: |
      TimestampNormalizer compiles its regexps once at package init time (or via sync.Once) and
      reuses them across calls. The replacement string is the literal "TIMESTAMP" for all
      patterns per prd001-testutils AC3.

acceptance_criteria:
  - id: AC1
    text: |
      A cmd/ package can define a []DiffTest slice and call RunDiffTests(t, goBinary,
      refBinary, tests) from a TestXxx function with no other setup beyond building the
      binaries (prd001-testutils AC1).
  - id: AC2
    text: |
      A passing test run produces no output on stdout or stderr. A failing test prints the
      triggering args, stdin (truncated), and both binaries' stdout, stderr, and exit code
      via t.Errorf (prd001-testutils AC2).
  - id: AC3
    text: |
      TimestampNormalizer replaces strftime-formatted timestamps (e.g., "Feb 19 12:34:56")
      with the fixed placeholder "TIMESTAMP" so that differential tests with wall-clock
      timestamps can pass despite timing differences (prd001-testutils AC3).
  - id: AC4
    text: |
      A DiffTest with a non-nil ExpectedFiles field correctly fails when the Go binary writes
      different file content than the reference binary to the same relative path
      (prd001-testutils AC4).
  - id: AC5
    text: |
      A DiffTest where either binary exceeds the 10-second timeout fails with a clear timeout
      message (naming the binary and args) rather than hanging the test run
      (prd001-testutils AC5).
  - id: AC6
    text: |
      All pkg/testutils code compiles with no warnings under golangci-lint
      (prd001-testutils AC6).
  - id: AC7
    text: go test ./pkg/testutils/... passes with no failures.
